name: tessera
description: Tessera — distributed reservation and inventory infrastructure engineered to keep inventory correct under extreme concurrent demand

scripts.up:obs: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile core --profile obs up -d
scripts.up:lab: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile core --profile obs --profile lab up -d
scripts.down: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile core --profile obs --profile lab down
scripts.psql: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml exec postgres psql -U tessera
